column1: # --dynmul magnitude scan. Everything else at compiled defaults.
# With dynmul>0 the static --cutoff is IGNORED (yals.c:5546-5549): the budget
# is purely dynamic -- each probe starts at 1000 flips and every probe-best
# improvement extends the deadline to D*(flips-so-far). Larger D lets improving
# probes run longer before the next improvement is required. dynmul=0 uses a
# flat static --cutoff (1000000 compiled default) for every probe.
